content: ScaDS.AI (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) is a German research center, jointly operated by the Universities of Leipzig and Dresden, that focuses on advancing scalable data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence methods across various scientific and application domains.
